description: This header file defines interfaces related to WebPA, including function prototypes for URL retrieval, message sending, device MAC retrieval, and component destination finding. It also includes macro definitions for device properties and external header inclusion.

methods.name: get_parodus_url
methods.description: Retrieves the URL where parodus is listening.

methods.name: Cosa_FindDestComp
methods.description: Finds the destination component and path given an object name.

methods.name: sendWebpaMsg
methods.description: Sends a WebPA message with specified parameters.

methods.name: rdk_logger_module_fetch
methods.description: Fetches the module name for logging purposes.
